name: autonomous-pr-review
description: Generic autonomous PR review methodology: verify before flagging, check PR-description metadata against the repo's own documented conventions, recognize restraint the repo's own style deliberately practices, and post findings with mandatory inline anchoring plus a mechanically-derived verdict.

interface.shortDescription: Verify-before-flagging PR review with inline-anchored findings
interface.longDescription: Generic, repo-agnostic pull request review methodology: run the repo's own checks, treat its AGENTS.md as the checklist, check PR metadata, show restraint, and post inline findings with a mechanically derived verdict.
